Matas Buzelis isn’t so sure about the concept of friendly competition — especially when it comes to Chicago Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson.

Only a few months after their first meeting, Buzelis and Wilson are already fast friends. But that doesn’t mean the pair lets each other off the hook. Buzelis feels the best way to translate that friendship onto the court is to channel it into a heightened competitiveness. And for his money, there’s one main way that either young star can make the other better.

“We can try to kill each other on the court,” Buzelis said.
